nodes.summary: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be matroids on a finite type $\alpha$, each with ground set all of $\alpha$, and let $k$ be a natural number. There is a set $I \subseteq \alpha$ independent in both $M_1$ and $M_2$ with $|I| \ge k$ if and only if every $X \subseteq \alpha$ satisfies $k \le r_1(X) + r_2(\alpha \setminus X)$, where $r_i$ is the rank function of $M_i$.
nodes.title: Edmonds' matroid intersection theorem for matroids on the whole type

nodes.summary: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be matroids on a finite type $\alpha$, with arbitrary ground sets, and let $k$ be a natural number. There is a set $I \subseteq \alpha$ independent in both $M_1$ and $M_2$ with $|I| \ge k$ if and only if every $X \subseteq \alpha$ satisfies $k \le r_1(X) + r_2(\alpha \setminus X)$, where $r_i(Y)$ is the largest size of a subset of $Y$ independent in $M_i$.
nodes.title: Edmonds' matroid intersection theorem

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a finite subset of a type $\alpha$, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $r_1, r_2$ be functions from the finite subsets of $\alpha$ to $\mathbb{N}$ such that, for $i = 1, 2$ and all finite $X, Y \subseteq \alpha$, we have $r_i(X) \le |X|$, $r_i(X) \le r_i(Y)$ whenever $X \subseteq Y$, and $r_i(X \cap Y) + r_i(X \cup Y) \le r_i(X) + r_i(Y)$.
